# GolfPrice AI: full handover (27 Nov 2026)

Written for a new Claude chat taking over from the long build chat (Nov 2026). Read this first, then the files it points to. Everything important lives in this repo; nothing depends on the old chat.

**How to start a new chat:** "Read .github/HANDOVER.md in 557tggwysr-ui/golfpriceai-site and carry on as my GolfPrice AI partner." Attach the repo with push access.

## 1. John and how he works

- **John Willson**, founder, runs GolfPrice AI solo alongside a full-time job. UK, Windows, no coding background. Claude Pro plan; ChatGPT Go (makes all images there). No Excel. Calls Claude "partner".
- **Every change arrives as an opened pull request** into `main`. John merges; Claude never merges and never commits to `main`. Bundle related changes into one PR; keep urgent ones separate and say "merge now".
- **Agents fix as well as find**, but John approves every change (merging is approval).
- Plain English, short phone-friendly replies, honest risk-flagging. He wants mock-ups before big creative builds.
- **Free, or within the Pro plan.** Paid only with his say-so (approved: up to USD 10 per fortnight for one OpenMontage "hero" video he runs on his PC).
- **Keep usage, traffic and money numbers private** (direction only in messages; figures only on the key-locked private stats page and the analyst's email).
- Repo is public; never commit secrets (the GSC service-account .json key must never go in).

## 2. The business and the brand

- **golfpriceai.com**: UK golf price-comparison affiliate site. Tagline **"Full Swing. Not full price."** Promise: no hype, no fake discounts, just better golf gear prices.
- Revenue: Awin affiliate links (publisher, promotional type "Comparison Engine"). Retailer feeds (secrets `AWIN_*_FEED_URL`): Clickgolf, Affordable Golf, Callaway, Callaway Preowned, Clarkes Golf, Major Golf, PAYNTR, Scottsdale Golf. Applied to all golf retailers on Awin plus Greaves Sports, Net World Sports, Reflo (golf products only). Amazon Associates (golfpriceai-21), CJ account (no advertiser yet).
- Competitors watched: Caddence, CaddyCompare, Golf Price Compare, ClubCompass, RiddyGolf, plus whatever the monthly scout finds (never a fixed list).
- Long-term: the UK one-stop shop for golfers ("Golf Ecosystem" is an internal term only, never public).
- Accounts: Instagram @golfpriceai, TikTok @golfprice.ai, YouTube channel UCfAw38hJZ0gYvI0q-NMKqaQ, Pinterest uk.pinterest.com/golfpriceai, Bluesky (auto-posts), X. **No Facebook page** (refused). Reddit u/JohnSarcastic suspended (appeal 18 Nov). Contact GolfPriceAI@outlook.com (hello@golfpriceai.com forwards). Wikidata Q141969698. Open data on Kaggle (golfpriceai), Zenodo, Hugging Face.

## 3. House rules (never bend)

Full versions: `.github/EDITOR.md` (house style, read by the Editor agent) and `.github/SOCIAL.md` (social brief).
- **Never name retailers** in public or marketing copy: "multiple UK retailers".
- **No fake urgency**, countdowns, "only 2 left", or **"was" prices**. "Lowest we've tracked" only when true; "new low" only if the low is from the last 2 days.
- **Positive framing**: show what IS genuinely cheaper.
- **#Ad at the start** of every caption on a post showing a specific product and price (ASA/CAP).
- Tone: golf-club banter plus gentle humour ("think Bob Does Sports"). **Never political, never tragic news, never anyone's real photograph**, never a real person implied to endorse us.
- Original work only; no other brand's assets, logos, characters or music. Event tie-ins borrow colours and mood only (Doomsday = black and green).
- Video: music with a beat, **cut on the beat**, sound effects in moderation, no swoosh on every cut. Never invent trends or sounds. **No words baked into photos** (text is added as layers).
- Characters are fictional: banter never bullying, everyone gets a win sometimes, tools shown only as they really are, no invented prices.
- Men's items lead listings (women's shown, not leading). Used/ex-demo/Callaway Preowned stock only in Clubs > Preowned and trade-ins.
- UK spelling.

## 4. Systems

| Part | Where |

| Site | Plain HTML/CSS/JS on **GitHub Pages**, repo `557tggwysr-ui/golfpriceai-site`, domain at Namecheap. Many pages are generated by Python scripts in `scripts/` (e.g. `price_pages.py` → `/prices/<model>/`, `seasonal_pages.py`, `site_chrome.py` = header/menu on ~2,700 pages, `home_v2_build.py` = homepage). Change the script, not just the output. |
| Data | `data/products.json` (~80k listings from feeds, refreshed every 6h by `update_deals.py`), `data/models.json` (price history per model), `data/home-deals.json`, etc. |
| Backend | **Cloudflare Worker** `workers/alerts-worker.js` (~4,750 lines) with a **D1** database: price/back-in-stock alerts, Fourball alerts, Par Price, leagues, Wild Nine scores/groups/avatars (`/wn/...`), Society HQ (`/soc/...`), live scorecard (`/sc`), Bag Draft, polls, Clubhouse keys and passkeys, stats. **John deploys it by hand**: Cloudflare → Workers & Pages → the alerts worker → Edit code → paste the file → Deploy. Free Workers plan. Tables are created by the worker itself ("no such table" on first run is fine). |
| Email | **Brevo** (Friday "Genuine Drops" at 16:00 UK, alerts, journalist list). |
| Analytics | GA4 G-7ZQDX25S1W and Microsoft Clarity, only after cookie consent. Search Console via service account (secret `GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`), Bing Webmaster Tools. SEO connector chosen: Windsor.ai (free, GSC only). |
| Socials | Instagram Graph API (secrets `IG_USER_ID`, `IG_ACCESS_TOKEN`: an "EAA" Facebook-login token, so `ig_api()` uses graph.facebook.com), Bluesky (`BLUESKY_HANDLE`, `BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD`), YouTube Data API key (read only). |
| Claude in Actions | `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (the Editor and some agents call Claude). |
| MCP | The site publishes its own MCP connector (`server.json`, workflow `publish-mcp.yml`); John has it connected as "GolfPrice_AI". |

Secrets in use (names only): ALERTS_SECRET, AWIN_* (API token, publisher id, advertiser id, 8 feed URLs), BLUESKY_*, BREVO_API_KEY, CF_ACCOUNT_ID, CF_API_TOKEN, CH_API_KEY (Companies House: **not added yet**, step D5 left for later), CJ_*, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, GA, GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, HF_TOKEN, IG_*, KAGGLE_*, PSI_API_KEY, YOUTUBE_API_KEY, ZENODO_TOKEN.

**Claude-side notes:** in Claude sessions GitHub's GraphQL API is blocked: use REST (`gh api repos/...`), e.g. open PRs with `gh api repos/557tggwysr-ui/golfpriceai-site/pulls -f title -f head -f base=main -f body`, download release assets with `gh api -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" repos/.../releases/assets/<id>`. Commit as `git -c user.name=Claude -c user.email=noreply@anthropic.com`, push with `git -c push.negotiate=true push`. Work in a git worktree per change off `origin/main`.

## 7. Social media: how it runs now

**Read `.github/SOCIAL.md` and `.github/EDITOR.md`.** Engine: `scripts/agent_content.py` (+ `agent_video.py`, `agent_cine.py`, `agent_brush.py`, `agent_audio.py`, `agent_social.py`, `agent_heist.py`, `agent_newsroom.py`, `agent_editor.py`).

- **Modes** (Actions → "Agent: content engine" → Run workflow → pick mode → green Run workflow): `plan` (Sun 17:00: next week), `trends` (Wed), `moment` (08:15 and 17:45: newsroom + price moments), `post` (12:30 and 19:30), `sound`, `resound`, `remake` (rebuilds this week's guess videos, tips carousels, price moments), `hishers` (adds His & Hers to the next two Sundays).
- **Approval**: each post has a tick box in a GitHub issue labelled `content-pack` (weekly pack issue, same-day issues, "His & Hers: tick to approve"). Only ticked posts auto-post. If no pack issue is open, same-day posts get their own issue.
- **Auto-posting**: Instagram and Bluesky at the post's slot. John posts TikTok, YouTube Shorts, X and Pinterest himself from the **content pack page** `golfpriceai.com/social/pack/` (5-week schedule at the top with status: ✓ Posted / Ticked / To tick / Held; tap ▶ Watch; captions per platform; suggested times; downloads).
- **Timing test** (from 24 Nov, four weeks): posts alternate lunchtime 12:30 v evening 19:30 (`SLOTS`, `slot_test`); Monday's 11:43 message asks John "lunch or evening" from his TikTok/YouTube analytics.
- **Weekly rhythm**: Wed **The Fourball** (Big Dave, Phil, Steady Steve, Gaz, Kev; fixed day), Fri **Price Check Friday**, fortnightly **Myth or Mulligan** and **Budget or Bougie?**, Sun 19:30 **His & Hers**; plus price drops, Wild Nine, guess games ("Higher or lower? No googling": the real price comes in UNDER the guess, covers never show the answer), tips carousels (colour journeys, real products with today's price), memes from `data/social-bank.json` + photos in `data/social-library.json`, event tie-ins from `data/moments.json` / `data/content-queue.json`, and same-day newsroom posts.
- **Every post**: original music (Fourball keeps its theme), a polished cover matching the video's colours, TikTok caption = same full message as Instagram, one claim per platform, suggested release times, **story hashtag first on news/event posts** (#Doomsday, #BlackFriday: newsroom gives `tags`), posts' video files live on GitHub releases `pack-<monday>`.
- **The Editor**: holds posts that break rules or the premium visual standard. Holds are in `data/agents/editor-holds.json`; a post John has released goes in its `released` list and **is never re-held** (fixed 25 Nov after Doomsday was held three times). To release: PR removing the id from `posts` + a `released` entry.
- **Posting windows**: a timed run that GitHub starts late only posts 11:45–16:00 or 18:45–23:00 UK; otherwise it stops (a 19:30 run once arrived at 03:07). Manual runs always post. Saves retry on push races.

## 9. Known gotchas (learned the hard way)

- **GitHub's scheduled runs are unreliable** (delayed hours or skipped). For important posts, check after the slot and start the run manually (Actions → content engine → post). The watchdog flags agents that are late.
- **"Run workflow" needs the final green button**; John has missed it once (remake didn't run).
- Several agents commit to `main` at once: all workflows now retry the push 5 times.
- When a cover or card looks off, the Editor will hold the post: fix the visuals at the source (engine code), not just the file.
- Cookie banner covers the buy button on phones on first visit (shopper agent flags it daily) — a slimmer banner is a pending suggestion.
- 7 club **shafts are filed as clubs** (e.g. "ACCRA FX 3.0 Shaft" under drivers), spoiling those pages' lowest prices — pending tidy-up.
- The Instagram token is a long-lived EAA token: when posting fails with an auth error, John regenerates it in Meta's app dashboard and updates the `IG_ACCESS_TOKEN` secret.
- The worker must be re-pasted into Cloudflare by John whenever `workers/alerts-worker.js` changes.
